visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a muscular Asian man, shirtless and wearing a black baseball cap, jogging energetically towards the camera on a Taipei street. He is talking animatedly, his mouth wide and eyes focused. Parked scooters and multi-story apartment buildings line the background under a soft overcast sky. (2) As he continues his run into a narrow side alley, he maintains his fast pace and eye contact with the viewer. He wears loose black satin-like pants. The camera follows him in a smooth tracking shot, capturing his physical exertion and large muscle definition. (3) He suddenly reaches down and pulls off his outer black pants while still running, revealing black athletic compression shorts underneath. He tosses the pants to the side and continues sprinting, gesturing with his hands while shouting at the camera with an intense, comedic expression. (4) The scene cuts to a static, brightly lit promotional graphic. Two muscular men, including the runner, pose with protein powder packets and tennis rackets in a studio setting. Bold text overlays describe a 'GO BIG GO DOUBLE' sale event with various discount percentages and dates.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-tempo Japanese rock track with distorted electric guitars and driving drums kicks in immediately. A male voice shouts 'Ge!' at a high volume, followed by rapid-fire speech. His breathiness is audible, indicating physical exertion. The pitch is high and the tone is urgently persuasive. (2) A sharp percussive thud and the rustling sound of fabric occur as the speaker lets out a strained grunt. He continues his narration with high vocal arousal and pitch variability. The BGM remains constant in energy, providing a dense acoustic backdrop for the high-intensity vocal delivery. (3) The vocal intensity peaks as the speaker yells about shopping discounts. His articulation remains clear despite the fast speech rate. The electric guitar in the BGM performs a melodic lead line that synchronizes with the frantic energy of the speech. No other ambient noises interfere. (4) The audio transitions with a final rhythmic drum hit and a bright synthesized shimmer. The vocal narration ceases, leaving the final musical chord to ring out briefly before the video ends. The overall mix is compressed and bright, typical of high-energy social media advertisements.
